purpose: Combined label governance: standard labelling (config validation, label sync, template guardrail, labelling agent, report), bare-label detection, Dependabot security label, status-label clean-up on issue close, and a required 'Labeling Governance Check' status on PRs.
triggers: pull_request: branches [develop], types [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
discussion: types [created, edited, answered, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs.summary: Validate labeling configs and issue fields, run label-sync.js, check-template-labels.js, run-labeling-agent.js, report-writer.js; upload report; optionally commit report to develop.
Load labels.yml with js-yaml and warn when the current PR/issue carries labels outside the canonical set (warning only).
On Dependabot PRs, create meta:dependabot-security if missing and add/remove it based on CVE/GHSA/vulnerability patterns in title and body.
On issue close, remove status:needs-triage, status:in-progress and status:needs-review.
Needs standard-labeling; requires at least one type:/area:/priority:/meta: label, creates or updates a 'Labeling Governance Check' check run and fails the job when requirements are not met.

failure_points.issue: scripts/validation/validate-issue-fields.cjs currently exits 1 (10 project Type mappings missing from labels.yml, docs/ISSUE_FIELDS.md missing type:docs; run locally on 2026-09-24), so standard-labeling would fail and the required check would fail on every PR.
label-sync.js only exports functions and has no entrypoint, so the 'Sync labels with canonical set' step does nothing.
report-writer.js uses `require.main === module` in an ES-module package ("type": "module", package.json:50) and throws ReferenceError (reproduced locally), failing 'Generate report'.

detect-bare-labels reads `github.event_name` inside github-script, where `github` is the Octokit client; the value is undefined, so PR runs always read context.payload.issue and skip. Detection only warns.
label-dependabot-security creates meta:dependabot-security at runtime, bypassing the locked labels.yml.
labeling-check hard-codes status=success, so the failure-comment branch is dead code.
A meta:* label alone satisfies the required-label check, so a PR with only meta:needs-changelog passes without any type:* label.
Same push/pull_request/issues/discussion triggers as labeling.yml; both ran the labelling agent on the same events.
report_commit pushes to develop while the workflow only has contents: read, so the push fails.
dry_run is ignored: run-labeling-agent.js calls runLabelingAgent() with no options and the agent reads only opts.dryRun, never DRY_RUN.
push and discussion events run a full npm install, but the agent returns immediately without an issue or PR in context.
